meta.description: CP4 evidence (T-016): byte-identical inputs to scored-run.json but with NO flags — the shipped default six-face run. The A/B control: proves the flags-off run still plays the stock lives path (setbacks absent, protoScore falls back to the labeled proxy) and gives the comparison trace for the CP4 packet.

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

servedFixture.source: window.HB.fixture + HB.snapshot() on the served page

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: stock lives spent on the default six-face run (player.lives decreases; fixtures do not spend lives, this run is not one). HULL FALLBACK absorptions (?fallback=1) cost no life — see metrics.score.setbacks — so a fallback-armed run's failure story is both numbers.

lives.note: stock lives spent, from player.lives on the telemetry channel. Inside a fixture this is 0 by design — fixtures retry instead of spending a life; metrics.deaths names the counter that applies to THIS run.

route.unavailableReason: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against

darePocket.unavailableReason: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against

protoScore.unavailableReason: the A.5 `links` term cannot be approximated on this build: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against. Run with ?score=1 for the game's own event-derived link count (metrics.score), which needs no route matcher.
